_comment: DESIGN.md section 9: make skins datapack-loadable from v1 so community contributions cost
only a merge. This file is that promise. Adding a hair is one PNG under
assets/namesake/textures/entity/villager/hair/ and one line here - no Java change at all.
Order does not matter, and appending does not reshuffle anybody. Selection is rendezvous
hashing over each id, so adding a variant moves about one villager in n onto it and leaves
every other villager in the world exactly as they were. A modulus would have repainted the
neighbour a player knew by her hair, because somebody's pull request was merged.
A resource pack may override this file entirely. If it lists nothing usable, the mod's own
built-in set is used instead - a broken pack costs a player their variety, not their
Clothing is deliberately NOT here: a clothing shape is chosen by profession rather than by
seed, because it is what re-earns vanilla's profession overlay after the renderer swap
